subject: general
question: The population of a district is 376000, out of which 230000 are males. 11% of the population is literate. If 11% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **literacy rate** = 11%

**Male literacy rate** = 11%

Since the literacy rate of the **total population** and the **male population** is the same (11%), the **female literacy rate** must also be 11% to maintain the average.

Weighted Average Rule: If Part A is 11% and the Total is 11%, then Part B must be 11%.

**∴ The correct answer is 11%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Population = 376000

Total Males = 230000

Total Literate Population = 11% of 376000

Male Literate Population = 11% of 230000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b58476bf337eb1e8196051ee584ef2757d3f51811a642c9eef8024c680e58a1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total females = Total population − Total males

⇒ Total females = 376000 − 230000 = 146000

⇒ Total literate persons = 0.11 × 376000 = 41360

⇒ Literate males = 0.11 × 230000 = 25300

⇒ Literate females = Total literate − Literate males

⇒ Literate females = 41360 − 25300 = 16060

⇒ Female literacy % = (Literate females ÷ Total females) × 100

⇒ Female literacy % = (16060 ÷ 146000) × 100 = 11%

**∴ The correct answer is 11%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Principle

When the average of the whole group is equal to the average of one sub-group, the average of the second sub-group must also be equal to the overall average.

Literacy Calculation

Literacy Percentage = (Number of Literates ÷ Total Population) × 100. This can be applied to specific genders or the entire population.</p
